posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
My pleasure, guys! This one was a blast--right down to the wire... So who's starting the next one? I want to play!

 

As her allies gape, shocked by the risen Gloomweaver's savagery, Parse stands, silently calculating angles and trajectories.  With a start, she cries out, "Paige!  Left kneecap, then the shin below it!"  KNYFE leaps to action, hammering the demon-beast's knee with her servo-gauntlet, then slicing across Gloomweaver's leg with her mighty energy blade.  As KNYFE slides down to the desert below, Parse nocks and fires two arrows.  The first sinks deep into Gloomweaver's forehead, while the second pins the demon's right food to a piece of scrub foliage.  The demon stumbles, roars a final time, then crashes lifeless to the desert floor.  Its form discorporates into so much refuse and rot, its relics vanishing, surely to be collected once more by Gloomweaver's deluded faithful.

Ra steps forward.  "Anubis, my brother..."

The Naturalist steps forward, "He hated you, did he not?"

"No," Ra murmurs, "Not hate...we are an old people.  We hold long memories and longer grudges."

"Perhaps, then, at the end, he forgave you?"  The Naturalist clasps Ra on the shoulder, "Perhaps the rest of the Ennead may someday do the same."

"Under less tragic circumstances, hopefully."  Ra turns and begins walking into the desert.

"Master Ra!" Omnitron-X starts, "To what location do you travel?"

"Nowhere..."
